scope: Compact Dart hover presentation, whole-symbol request reuse and confirmed definition navigation feedback
working_tree: Preserves existing uncommitted builds 21-24. No commit/push performed in this task.
implementation: Bounded parsing of LSP Markdown/MarkedString/plaintext into signature, declaration, type and documentation
Intrinsic-height rounded child panel without an arrow/focus request; signature colors, safe inline Markdown, lower-right menu and optional expanded docs
One cancellable worker slot per document, concurrent hover/definition, complete Unicode identifier hits instead of nearest-whitespace hits
140 ms dwell for uncached normal hover, zero dwell for Command hover; movement within a word does not reset dwell or requests
16-entry semantic-context LRU including negative results; edits/open/close/restart/Pub completion invalidate stale context
Confirmed definition temporary underline and pointing hand; middle click, Command-click and Command-B, complete cached locations reused
Diagnostic underline restoration, edit/scroll/focus/resize/theme cleanup, delayed card entry with whitespace bridge
Anchor-screen placement including negative coordinates and screen-edge clamping

external_sdk.location: Explicit installed external SDK, local absolute path intentionally omitted
external_sdk.diagnostics_version: Dart 3.11.5 omits push diagnostic versions. Ordering gates cannot prove freshness; diagnostics never drive automatic text writes.

verification.sequence: Run before the final menu-expansion threshold fix; only app presentation changed afterward. Final app was release-compiled and strict-format checked again; model sources/tests unchanged.

verification.limit: Pure Foundation geometry/parser/state tests; Swift address checks only, no AppKit host or Rust instrumentation.

SDK hover range matches local identifier range
type diagnostics and unsaved incremental fix
verification.timing_limit: Single tiny fixture after analysis readiness; not a benchmark, UI latency, project indexing or FPS result.
